Synopsis:
When a paladin becomes an oathbreaker the Oathbreaker knight will appear to be their guide. He will stay at the camp as a camp follower.If a non-oathbreaker paladin speaks to the Oathbreaker, they begin a short interactive dialogue. The Oathbreaker is mildly impressed that they are still dedicated to their cause, but warns that the course ahead will test their commitment.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_OathbreakerKnight.json: The Oathbreaker Knight is a former paladin who abandoned his oath after he discovered his lord’s corruption and killed him; he now lingers at the player camp as a grim guide for paladins. This brief, repeatable camp exchange triggers when a (non‑oathbroken) paladin speaks to him and is delivered in a controlled, measured tone as he explains his past and the consequences of breaking an oath. He is mildly impressed that the player remains dedicated but warns that the road ahead will test their commitment and that a different, darker power can awaken if an oath is broken. He also notes that reclaiming an oath is possible but costly—requiring sacrifice and a formal re‑pledge—and offers to speak further if you choose to pursue it. Other camp companions may be present during the conversation, but they do not change the Oathbreaker’s focus on your choices and future.
- GLO_PaladinOathbreaker_PAD_BrokeOath.json: Paladin players breaks their oath and reacts to it.
- CAMP_Ravengard.json: Default Ravengard dialogue. Depending on the path, Ravengard may urge you to save the city, and if Wyll is in party, will offer the quest to go to the Wyrmway. Wyll's endgame state is detremined here: He may become a Duke, the Blade of Avernus, or remain the Blade of Frontiers
- LOW_BhaalTemple_InWorldAbduction_Nested.json: Nested dialogue. After impersonating a member of the player's camp (in camp or on entering the undercity), Orin reveals herself and delivers an ultimatum to the player: kill Gortash, or she will kill the abductee. Dark Urge players receive an alternate flow, where their shared background and rivalry is more present.
- CAMP_Night2_CRD_Wyll.json: The player talks to Wyll on their second night at camp.
